notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes: A patch to fix an odd glitch that reduced the ship speed after saving the game while traveling to a destination.

notes.title: New Big Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39111356/89f9a6fec1df2e1e0a0dec5e0bc796d3f2fe502c.png

This New Version Contains:

Main updates
*Step Sounds Added to the Game.
*Added Step Sounds Options in the Audio Settings.
*General Polish to various Guardian Stations, from sound effect to cinematic scenes.
*Polished the NeoCharger, from audio to pictures.
*Polished the Title Menu Presentation.
*Polish to the Pulsating Generator.
*Increased the limit of save files to 5. 
*Better performance and timing for the Jumping mechanic.
*Polished dialogues across all of the game.
*Increased the Image caché limit of the game.
*Polish to the Color Balance of the Tilesets, for walls and roof textures mostly.

Additional updates
*When start a New Game, the naming scenes have smoother musical transitions.
*The sprite for the Magnetic Keys Dispenser got better coloring.
*Some polish to one of the cinematics of the first outpost station.
*Better contrast coloring for the server modules on the first outpost station.
*Some Polish for two pictures, that are background styles for displaying text.
*The Sprite of the Data Centers Change reflects its state better.
*Added some coloring to Keywords present in some Dialogues, across all of the game.
*Changed the color of the PopUp Starting Dialogue Effect for Characters.
*Added some shadows to the sprites like the shields dispenser, the neocharger and others.
*Changed the default destination character to "?"
*Changed the color effect of the screen, for when opening a big container.
*Added two new Fanfare Effects, for when the game is over and when reaching a destination.
*A little less transparency to the MainSpaceship HUDs.
*Added some sound effects for certain system dialogues.
*Polished the Items Obtained Scene (Rewards Screen.)
*Polished the Background Picture when Taking a Pulsating Core.
*Added a Melody Effect when obtaining a Map Card.
*More Contrast to the Operators sprite.
*Added some sound effects when entering a spatial station.
*Polished the animation when a Master Processor is obtained.
*Polished the ground layers texture of the racing mini-game.
*Fixed a forced effect of The Escape Teleporter Switch.
*Added a globe emoticon to one of the description scenes.
*Some little polish to the spaceship coloring variants.
*Some little polish to angry and hearth globe emoticons.
*Upgrade the scene when a robotic merchant explains the capacitors meanwhile in an abandoned cargo ship.
*Corrected when certain doors (for the escape pods,) changed color due interactions.
*Added a special illumination for when the player runs out of water and food, if the area is not already illuminated.
*Renamed the "Punch Card" item to: "Data Card" 

Have nice adventures exploring the sidereal space!

notes.title: Small Update for the Sountrack DLC
notes.notes:
1. The music files are now directly into the folder instead of being inside another. It was redundant.
2. The music tracks have been renamed with a numeric index, so they can be played in the proper order.

notes.title: Dialogues Update.
notes.notes:
This month update went to more dialogues to enrich the experience:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39111356/a34af93e902d0ecd6c719519cfc07b5db98009f4.png

Main:
I. Added 7 more reactive dialogues related to the Guardian Stations.
II. Added 3 new conversations for the story progression.
III. 2 more conversations that happens in the asteroid belts.
IV. Added 1 icon animation variation when using the bathroom.

New workarounds:
1. For players that were very advanced in the game and couldn’t trigger the speed mini game; The map will appear in the navigation interface automatically.
2. The informative icon that shows a possible destination in the navigation interface is now displayed even if the player did not investigate the first one that shows up (The Aldebaran Station.) (Is not necessary but it looks cooler that way.)
3. A better recovery movement after the ship receives an asteroid impact; of this way, in the remote possibility you got a very hard RNG asteroid field and got trapped in an infinite collision loop due to a narrow space, you can have the chance to move out of it.
4. The destination sprite for the first time discovered spatial stations or centers looks more distinctive and better now.

New Fixes:
1. In the first Hyper Jump dialogue, the text was a little too long for the canvas. Is now fixed.
2. There were times in which the animation of the asteroid passing through, suddenly disappear in the start of the first rescue mission, it is now fixed.
3. There was an extra character space in one of the resources dialogues, it is aligned now.

  
---Important Note: 

These times have been difficult due various events and it is hard to keep this updates going, there is a huge chance that this is probably the last one I will be able to make. Really want to say thanks to all of you for the support. As intended, the work hours will be onto the next title (need to stay focused); thanks again and wish you a good weekend.

notes.title: Big General Update
notes.notes:
General Upgrades:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39111356/bb7c9826c69d36b113fa7b43c963e88a27ece92e.png
A new type of map will appear after a shooting star in the Navigation Interface.
Taking a bath now may give you extra Action Points under certain conditions or extra speed.
More feedback dialogues added into the game.
New option to craft shields using the speakers.
The Green robot tutorial scene has been retouched.
Polished the message scene when the 8 master processors have been collected.
If you missed a painting inside an abandoned cargo starship a new merchant will appear in the decoration center, it will allow you to buy it. If you missed a painting in a main stage or in the rescue mission it will still be lost forever, a new type of frame will appear indicating it.
In the outpost station, there were added NPCs and the possibility to obtain a capacitor.
The submarine and laser levels perform better to prevent lag if any.
Added two blue submarines that give speed to the player, hidden in their respective level.
In the labyrinth stage there were added more respawn points, so it is easier for the player evade the backtracking.

Animations and visuals:

The wall decoration function of the Modular PC got an upgrade. (You can buy it in the Decoration Shop.)
Added two background asteroids as environmental decorations in the exploration zones.
Added 8 new roof’s variations for the Cargo Ships.
The item animations obtained are smoother and faster.
Added colored hangars for the items in the Star Paths.
New sprites for the center stations in the navigation interface.
The wall textures for the random generated cargo starships has been upgraded.
The frame mechanic used for paintings, is now smoother.
Some new map retouches for the Saptial Centers like the action points shop, making them more distinctive.
Adding a background picture for the last secret story log.
Added visuals for obtaining a map card and nares.
After finishing an exploration there is a little scene of traveling instead of just words with a black screen.
Making the Shooting Star appearance faster to evade interruptions.
The lasers sprites have transparency making them look better.
Some parallax retouches, like in the main title.
Adding a little extra animation to the modules sprites in the outpost station.

Sound and Music:

A better response to the background music of the end result screen after an exploration.
Better music response when day 0 arrives (music speed and an arrow animation.)
Added a mini sound at the end of some dialogues, like when taking metal components in the asteroid fields to give better sound feedback at the end of the messages.

Glitch fixes and programming retouches:

There was an unnecessary extra animation and delay when nothing was found; it is now faster.
The rescue mission’s auto-save is now taken into account, so the save reminder will not trigger again.
The text for finding diskettes in the outpost station, is now clearer.
There was an odd passing comet that persisted after the player enter the abandoned cargo starship, it is now removed.
Better response from the menu when entering the starship home map.
Fixed a glitch about some missing paintings in the interface when traveling to a destination.
Fixed the slow frame animation for certain items in the laser level.
Fixed the black screen glitch when traveling between the stations if chosen the same point of origin.
The sprite flashing before blinking has been fixed.

Thanks and enjoy!

notes.title: New Game Update
notes.notes:
1. Mouse Cursor is now hidden from the start of the game.
2. More responsive Control Instructions Scene of the Title Menu.
3. A mini picture of the keyboard is displayed in the Title Menu when first charged.
4. Some visual clues for the cursors on Tittle Menu.
5. Fixed orthography mistakes.
6. The Progress in the outpost station is now smoother.
7. More visual clues for the Navigation Interface added.
8. There has been added, a new map that guarantees a Map Card to the player. It also has a new environmental animation.
9. There is also a new cargo ship quest that guarantees a basic capacity upgrade.
10. A new type of NPC was added to the Guardian Stations:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39111356/709803a093033a9407865f471c6e3de562494cc4.png
Happy Holidays.
